name: Personality
install:
test -f index.html
test -f shape-discovery.html
test -f logo.svg
start:
set -euo pipefail
if curl -sf -o /dev/null --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8080/index.html; then
  echo "static server already listening on 8080"
  exit 0
fi
exec python3 -m http.server 8080 --bind 0.0.0.0 --directory /workspace
